title: expectrail.receipt-attestation/v1
description: The predicate of a GitHub artifact attestation whose subject is an Expectrail receipt file. Every field but format and receiptSha256 is copied from the receipt; the reader refuses an attestation where any copy differs from the receipt it is checked against. Predicate type: https://expectrail.tech/attestation/receipt/v1.

receiptSha256.description: SHA-256 of the receipt file's exact bytes: the attestation's subject digest.
